reviews.text:
Thank you for your continued support.

The doctors and nurses here are truly kind and helpful.

I'm so grateful for the doctors and nurses who listen attentively to even the slightest changes in my dog's condition.

If anything happens, I highly recommend this hospital!!!

If you get a doctor who seems inexperienced, they're bad at giving injections and don't provide proper treatment. When I went to a different hospital and had my medication and treatment changed, symptoms that hadn't healed for months improved immediately. There are good doctors there, but it feels like you get a "doctor lottery." Also, if they don't like a particular patient, they'll avoid them unless you specifically request them, deliberately assign them to another doctor, or act unfriendly.

I'd always had misgivings about this, so I only went there for vaccinations.

When my toes swelled, they took an X-ray right away. After checking that there were no bone abnormalities, they found a wound on my toes and diagnosed that as the likely cause.
(If they had examined the wound first, an X-ray wouldn't have been necessary.)

When I had a full body check before the vaccine, they told me I had tartar buildup and severe periodontal disease. They recommended I buy this toothpaste (a product available at the hospital) to brush my teeth with, but when I asked about its effectiveness, they told me it wouldn't improve my symptoms and would only provide a temporary relief.
I was worried about my periodontal disease, so I went to another hospital later, but they told me that my condition wasn't severe and was normal for my age.

Also, when I went in for my vaccination, they said, "The vaccine is done," but there was some vaccine dripping onto the examination table.
When I asked, "Did you get the shot?"
They said, "It may not have been in the shot, so we'll give you another shot." I became worried and asked, "If even a small amount of this gets into your body, isn't there a risk of getting a second shot?" " I asked, "What do you mean?" He replied, "One possibility is that the antibodies will increase. Also, the chances of an allergic reaction increase."
If that's the case, they should have explained this up front, and they shouldn't have proceeded on their own judgment.

Since the veterinary clinic is also a business, I understand that they would prioritize sales, as in the two incidents mentioned above, but I felt untrustworthy when they took advantage of the patient's illness to increase the medical fee even slightly, rather than offering the owner the best option.

Regarding the third point, it may have been a new employee, but I think the hospital should have checked with a supervisor or taken the best possible action to avoid making me feel uneasy.

All of my experiences have occurred with different doctors.
With so many doctors, it may be inevitable that each one will have a different approach. However, it's very disappointing that they lack consideration for both animals and owners.
I think it's safer to find a doctor you can trust and request their services.

It was great when I was using a male teacher, but when I got a female teacher it was the worst. They added all sorts of things without explaining the cost to me, which made the price skyrocket, and I felt like I was being completely ripped off, which was unpleasant. I will never go there again.

Since it was by appointment only, there was hardly any waiting time, and I was smoothly shown into the examination room. They were very good at handling specialized illnesses, and the staff were efficient and pleasant.

This is the hospital we always go to.

We take our cat there for checkups, and they seriously answer even the smallest questions.

The head veterinarian and all the other doctors are kind and thorough.

Some people say bad things about the female doctor, but she's not rude at all.

She's a very kind doctor.

We had to schedule a neutering surgery for the next day on short notice, but when I mentioned my concerns about her condition that day, they kindly said we could postpone it. They said we should wait until the owner's worries were alleviated.

All the doctors are very considerate of both animals and their owners.

We look forward to continuing to use their services.

It's clean, friendly, and has a great customer service.
There are often extra costs, including detailed checkups.
Consultations can be a little pricey.
